sections.summary: The speaker Hayashi Shigemitsu introduces himself to the audience and poses the central question of the talk: did you know that the shape of your hand changes your voice?
sections.summaryKo: 발표자 하야시 시게미츠가 청중에게 자기소개를 하고 이 강연의 핵심 질문을 던진다: 손 모양에 따라 목소리가 달라진다는 것을 알고 계십니까?
keyPoints: Self-introduction using humble speech (申します)
Opening with a rhetorical question to engage the audience
Playful comment: 'If you already know, I have nothing to offer'

sections.section: Experiment 1: Fist (グー) vs. Bent Fingers — Breathing Muscles
sections.summary: The speaker guides the audience through two breathing exercises — once with a fist (グー) and once with only the ring finger and little finger bent — to demonstrate which muscles activate: chest muscles (fist) vs. abdominal muscles (bent fingers).
sections.summaryKo: 발표자는 청중을 두 가지 호흡 실험으로 안내한다. 주먹(グー)으로 쥐었을 때는 가슴 근육이, 새끼손가락과 약지만 구부렸을 때는 복부 근육이 활발해짐을 직접 체험하게 한다.
keyPoints: Fist (グー) → chest muscles activate during deep breathing
Ring + little finger bent → abdominal muscles activate
Hand shape changes which breathing muscles are used
Changing muscles changes the way the voice comes out

sections.section: Live Demonstration: Raising a Seated Person with Voice
sections.summary: The speaker demonstrates the practical effect by using an audience volunteer (Watashi-san). Using a fist produces a strained, unstable voice that cannot raise the seated person. Using the bent-finger technique produces a stable, soft voice that can raise the person — revealing the power of the hand technique.
sections.summaryKo: 발표자는 청중 참가자(와타시 씨)를 활용한 라이브 시연을 보여준다. 주먹 쥔 상태에서는 막힌 불안정한 목소리가 나와 앉은 사람을 일으키지 못하고, 새끼·약지를 구부린 상태에서는 안정되고 부드러운 목소리로 사람을 일으킬 수 있음을 보여준다.
keyPoints: Fist → blocked, unstable voice → cannot raise seated person
Ring + little finger bent → stable, soft voice → can raise seated person
Reveals the real-world vocal power of the finger technique
打ち合わせ通り joke reveals pre-arranged participation

sections.section: Group Practice: Pairs Experiencing the Effect
sections.summary: The audience stands up and forms pairs. One person sits, the other stands. The standing person tries to raise the seated person using voice — first with a fist (グー), then with bent small fingers — experiencing the contrast directly. Roles are then reversed.
sections.summaryKo: 청중 전체가 일어서서 2인 1조를 이룬다. 한 사람은 앉고, 한 사람은 서서 목소리로 상대를 일으키는 체험을 한다. 먼저 주먹으로 시도하고, 이어 새끼·약지 구부리기로 시도하여 직접 차이를 체감한다. 역할을 바꿔 반복한다.
keyPoints: Audience forms pairs — one sits, one stands
First attempt with fist: breath gets stuck, belly engages
Second attempt with bent fingers: stable voice, can raise partner
Roles reversed so everyone experiences both sides
Joyful, dynamic exercise creates shared experience

sections.summary: After the pair exercises, the speaker explains practical benefits for people with stage fright, stuttering, or voice instability. He introduces an additional demonstration: imagining a disliked food destabilizes the body, while imagining a liked food restores stability — revealing the mind-body connection.
sections.summaryKo: 쌍 활동 후 발표자는 무대 공포증, 말더듬증 등 목소리 불안 문제를 가진 분들에게 실용적 해결책을 제시한다. 추가 시연으로 싫어하는 음식을 상상하면 신체가 불안정해지고, 좋아하는 음식을 상상하면 안정이 회복됨을 보여주며 심신의 연결을 드러낸다.
keyPoints: Small finger + ring finger bent → stable voice for public speaking
Applicable to stage fright (あがり症) and stuttering (喫音症)
Only one hand is sufficient; can cover with other hand
Mind also affects body: imagining disliked food → body weakens
Imagining liked food → body stabilizes
Physical + mental states are interconnected

signalExpressions.role: Formal greeting to open the talk

signalExpressions.expression: 皆様は〜をご存知でしょうか
signalExpressions.role: Introduces the central question/theme of the talk
Transitions to the next step in the demonstration

signalExpressions.expression: それを一つ試してみたいと思います

signalExpressions.role: Signals a shift to inviting the audience to participate

signalExpressions.expression: 是非皆様一緒にご体感していただきたいと思います
signalExpressions.role: Invites the entire audience to participate in the group exercise

signalExpressions.expression: どうぞお立ちくださいませ
signalExpressions.role: Requests audience to stand up for the group exercise

signalExpressions.expression: 二人一組になってください

signalExpressions.role: Transitions to the next phase of instruction after a prior step is done
Praises audience participation and marks success of the exercise

signalExpressions.expression: ありがとうございます どうぞおかけくださいませ
signalExpressions.role: Thanks the audience and invites them to sit back down

signalExpressions.expression: 人前でお話をするときに声が詰まってしまう〜方々
signalExpressions.role: Introduces the practical problem this technique addresses

signalExpressions.expression: ぜひこの小指と薬指を折り曲げておくと
signalExpressions.role: Presents the technique as a solution to the problem

signalExpressions.expression: さあもう一つ違うことを行います
signalExpressions.role: Introduces the second demonstration about mind-body connection

signalExpressions.expression: これをぜひまた皆様体感していただきたいと思います
signalExpressions.role: Invites the entire audience to experience the mind-body phenomenon
